review_type: Independent adversarial source, parity, and UI/UX review of parameter reboot requirement detection, post-save autopilot reboot prompting, and category tree search synchronization
verdict: REJECTED for exact-clone parity (Score: 6.5/10). Critical parameter management and UX parity capabilities verified: write_confirm_window checks param_meta::get(fw, name).reboot_required for all staged parameter edits, highlights affected parameters with '[Reboot Required]', and displays a prominent warning banner; post-save completion triggers reboot_prompt_window matching C# ConfigRawParams.cs L374-L377 prompting the operator to reboot the autopilot and dispatching MAV_CMD_PREFLIGHT_REBOOT_SHUTDOWN (command 246 param1=1.0); category tree search synchronization computes live matching counts ('+ {g} ({match_cnt})' and 'All ({total_matches})'), auto-synchronizes selected_group when a single group matches or when active category has 0 matches, and hides non-matching categories during active queries. findings.subsystem: Mobile Scoped Storage & Native SAF File Picker Bridge
evidence: document_roots() in crates/mp-app/src/platform.rs queries posix filesystem paths (/sdcard/Download, /storage/emulated/0).

On Android 11+ (API level 30+), Scoped Storage enforces SELinux isolation where direct posix access to /storage/emulated/0 is blocked for non-manager apps without using the Storage Access Framework (SAF / Intent.ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT). Similarly, iOS external file access requires UIDocumentPickerViewController to issue security-scoped resource bookmarks.
findings.impact: On modern Android and iOS devices, operators cannot access files in shared device storage or third-party cloud drives without OS SAF/DocumentPicker delegation.
findings.required_fix: Implement JNI intent dispatch for Android SAF (ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT / ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT) and Objective-C/Swift UIDocumentPickerViewController bindings on iOS.

findings.subsystem: Parameter Search Wildcard & Glob Pattern Matching
evidence: In C# ConfigRawParams.cs L1014 (filterList), search input is converted to a regex supporting asterisk wildcards: Regex filter = new Regex(searchfor.Replace('*', '.*').Replace('..*', '.*'), RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled | RegexOptions.Singleline);

In Rust ParamEditor (crates/mp-app/src/views/config.rs), filtering performs exact substring matching: k.to_lowercase().contains(&q) || param_meta::get(fw, k).map(|m| m.description.to_lowercase().contains(&q) || m.display_name.to_lowercase().contains(&q)).unwrap_or(false);
Queries containing wildcards (e.g. 'BATT*_VOLT' or 'SERVO*MIN') fail to match in Rust because '*' is treated as a literal character.
findings.impact: Operators searching for parameter families using standard Mission Planner wildcard patterns receive zero search results.
findings.required_fix: Enhance search matching in ParamEditor to support glob wildcard matching ('*') across parameter names and metadata.

evidence: In C# ConfigRawParams.cs L379-L385, after parameter writing completes, if the vehicle's parameter count changed (TotalReceived != TotalReported), Mission Planner notifies the operator: 'The number of available parameters changed, until full param refresh is done, some parameters will not be available.'
In Rust ParamEditor, parameter count changes resulting from enabling subsystems or script features are not detected post-save.
findings.impact: Operators enabling features that dynamically reveal new parameters on the vehicle are not alerted that a full parameter refresh is needed.
findings.required_fix: Check for total parameter count mismatch post-save and display an advisory toast/dialog prompting the operator to refresh parameters.

next_concrete_task: Implement glob wildcard search support ('*') in ParamEditor matching C# ConfigRawParams.cs L1014 regex filter, allowing operators to search parameter families with wildcards.
